source: robocasa a07e365 (v1.0.1) environments/kitchen atomic and composite task files: each target task's instruction (get_ep_meta lang) and success check (_check_success and the fixture and object_utils helpers it calls), restated; distances run from the gripper's grip point to the object's centre; keyed by the task the evaluator writes into review.task

notes.CloseBlenderLid: The blender's lid sits next to the blender; place it on top to close the blender. Success: the lid seated on the blender and the gripper at least 15 cm from the lid.
notes.CloseFridge: Close the fridge door (both doors on a French-door fridge). Success: every fridge door within 0.5% of its travel from closed, that is fully shut.
notes.CloseToasterOvenDoor: Close the toaster oven's door. Success: the door within 0.5% of its travel from closed, that is fully shut.
notes.CoffeeSetupMug: Pick the mug from the counter and place it under the coffee machine's dispenser. Success: the mug within 4 cm (x, y) and 10 cm (z) of the machine's cup spot under the dispenser, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the mug.
notes.NavigateKitchen: Drive the base from the start fixture to the named fixture (more than 1 m away) and face it; nothing is manipulated. Success: the base within 20 cm (x, y) of RoboCasa's standing spot in front of that fixture, its heading within about 11 degrees of facing the fixture. Only OpenWAM's rows move the base: a correction can stop a wrong drive but cannot drive.
notes.OpenCabinet: Open the cabinet's door (both doors on a double cabinet). Success: every door at least 90% of its travel open.
notes.OpenDrawer: Open the named drawer. Success: the drawer at least 95% of its travel out.
notes.OpenStandMixerHead: Tilt the stand mixer's head up. Success: the head more than 99% of its travel open.
notes.PickPlaceCounterToCabinet: Pick the object from the counter and place it in the cabinet. Success: the object inside the cabinet and the gripper at least 25 cm from it.
notes.PickPlaceCounterToStove: Pick the food from the plate and place it in the container on the stove. Success: the food touching the container, its centre within 7 cm (x, y) of the container's centre, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the food.
notes.PickPlaceDrawerToCounter: Pick the object from the open drawer and place it on the counter. Success: the object touching any counter and the gripper at least 25 cm from it.
notes.PickPlaceSinkToCounter: Pick the food from the sink and place it on the named container on the counter. Success: the food on the container (touching it, its centre within 70% of the container's radius (x, y) of the container's centre), the container touching the counter, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the food.
notes.PickPlaceToasterToCounter: Take the toasted item from the toaster and place it on a plate. Success: the item on the plate (touching it, its centre within 70% of the plate's radius (x, y) of the plate's centre) and the gripper at least 25 cm from the item.
notes.SlideDishwasherRack: Fully slide the dishwasher's top rack out or in, as the instruction says. Success: the rack at least 95% of its travel out (out) or at most 5% (in).
notes.TurnOffStove: Turn off the named burner with its knob. Success: that burner off.
notes.TurnOnElectricKettle: Press the electric kettle's lever down to switch it on. Success: the kettle switched on.
notes.TurnOnMicrowave: Press the microwave's start button. Success: the microwave on (the button works only while the door is less than 90% open) and the gripper at least 15 cm from the start button.
notes.TurnOnSinkFaucet: Turn on the sink faucet with its handle. Success: the water running.
notes.DeliverStraw: Take a straw from the drawer in front and put it into the glass cup on the dining counter. Success: the straw touching the glass cup, its centre within 50 cm (x, y) of the cup's centre, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the straw.
notes.GetToastedBread: Start the toaster with the bread in a slot; once the lever pops up, take the bread to the plate on the dining counter. Success: the toaster was switched on with the bread in a slot (this counts once it happens), the bread on the plate (touching it, its centre within 70% of the plate's radius (x, y) of the plate's centre), and the gripper at least 25 cm from the bread.
notes.KettleBoiling: Pick the kettle from the counter, place it on a stove burner and turn that burner on. Success: the kettle touching the stove, its centre within 15 cm (x, y) of a burner that is on, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the kettle.
notes.LoadDishwasher: Put the two named dishes from the counter into the dishwasher and close its door. Success: both dishes touching the top rack and the door within 5% of its travel from closed.
notes.PackIdenticalLunches: Put one vegetable and one meat item into each of the two tupperware containers on the nearby counter (two of each are given). Success: each container holds exactly one vegetable and one meat item (each touching it, its centre within 70% of the container's radius (x, y) of the container's centre), and the gripper is at least 25 cm from all four items.
notes.PreSoakPan: Put the pan and the sponge into the sink, then turn on the water. Success: the pan and the sponge entirely inside the sink, the water running, and the gripper at least 25 cm from both.
notes.PrepareCoffee: Take the mug from the cabinet, place it under the coffee machine's dispenser and press the start button. Success: the mug within 4 cm (x, y) and 10 cm (z) of the machine's cup spot under the dispenser, the machine started, the gripper at least 25 cm from the mug and at least 15 cm from the start button.
notes.RinseSinkBasin: Turn on the water and swing the spout across the basin. Success: the water has run with the spout turned left, centre and right, in any order (each position counts once reached with the water on).
notes.ScrubCuttingBoard: Pick up the sponge, scrub the cutting board with it, then release it. Success: while held, the sponge has touched the board at 5 or more spots, each at least 2 cm from the earlier ones and together spanning at least 10 cm, and the gripper is at least 15 cm from the sponge.
notes.SearingMeat: Take the pan from the cabinet and set it on the named burner, put the meat in the pan and turn that burner on. Success: the pan touching the stove, its centre within 15 cm (x, y) of the named burner, that burner on, the meat touching the pan with its centre within 7 cm (x, y) of the pan's centre, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the meat.
notes.SetUpCuttingStation: Place the knife from the drawer on the cutting board, then the meat from the plate. Success: the knife and the meat each on the board (touching it, its centre within 70% of the board's radius (x, y) of the board's centre), and the gripper at least 25 cm from the knife and from the board.
notes.StackBowlsCabinet: Stack the two bowls from the counter inside the open cabinet, the smaller on the larger. Success: both bowls inside the cabinet, one in the other (touching it, its centre within 70% of the lower bowl's radius (x, y) of the lower bowl's centre), and the gripper at least 25 cm from both.
notes.SteamInMicrowave: Put the vegetable from the sink into the bowl, put the bowl into the microwave, close the door and press the start button. Success: the vegetable in the bowl, the bowl inside the microwave, the door within 0.5% of its travel from closed, and the microwave on (the start button works only while the door is less than 90% open).
notes.StirVegetables: Put both vegetables into the pot, which stands on a burner that is already on, then take the spatula and stir. Success: on 5 control steps (not necessarily consecutive) the held spatula touches the vegetables while both are in the pot and moving, the pot still within 15 cm (x, y) of that burner and the burner on.
notes.StoreLeftoversInBowl: Put the chicken drumstick and the vegetable from their plates into the bowl, then put the bowl in the fridge. Success: both in the bowl (touching it, its centre within 70% of the bowl's radius (x, y) of the bowl's centre), the bowl touching a fridge shelf, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the bowl.
notes.WashLettuce: Hold the lettuce under the running sink water. Success: the lettuce under the running stream for 25 control steps in total (they need not be consecutive).
notes.ArrangeBreadBasket: Open the cabinet, put the bread from the cabinet into the basket, then move the basket to the dining counter. Success: the bread in the basket (touching it, its centre within 70% of the basket's radius (x, y) of the basket's centre), the basket touching the dining counter, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the basket.
notes.ArrangeTea: Place the kettle from the counter and then the mug from the cabinet on the tray, then close the cabinet doors. Success: the kettle and the mug each on the tray (touching it, its centre within 70% of the tray's radius (x, y) of the tray's centre), every cabinet door within 0.5% of its travel from closed, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the mug.
notes.BreadSelection: Among the pastries on the counter, place the croissant on the cutting board, then the jar of jam from the cabinet beside it. Success: the croissant and the jam each on the board (touching it, its centre within 70% of the board's radius (x, y) of the board's centre), and the gripper at least 25 cm from the croissant.
notes.CategorizeCondiments: Put the condiment bottle and the shaker from the counter into the cabinet, each next to its counterpart already there. Success: both inside the cabinet, the bottle within 15 cm (x, y) of the cabinet's bottle and the shaker within 15 cm of the cabinet's shaker, and the gripper at least 25 cm from both.
notes.CuttingToolSelection: Place the tool for cutting the named food's skin on the cutting board that holds the food: the knife for garlic, broccoli or avocado, the peeler for eggplant, carrot, cucumber or potato; both tools lie in the open drawer. Success: the right tool on the board (touching it, its centre within 70% of the board's radius (x, y) of the board's centre), the other tool not on it, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the board.
notes.GarnishPancake: Take the strawberry from the fridge and place it on the pancake, which lies on a plate on the dining counter. Success: the strawberry on the pancake (touching it, its centre within 70% of the pancake's radius (x, y) of the pancake's centre), the pancake on its plate, the plate touching the dining counter, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the strawberry.
notes.GatherTableware: Two cabinets stand open, two glasses and the bowl in one, the third glass in the other; the instruction asks to gather them into one cabinet with the glasses and the bowl on opposite sides. Success, as checked: the bowl's largest distance to a glass more than 1.5 times the largest distance between two glasses (the glasses together, the bowl apart), and the gripper at least 25 cm from each glass; the cabinet itself is not checked.
notes.HeatKebabSandwich: Put the kebab skewer and the baguette into the toaster oven, close its door and set the timer. Success: both touching a toaster-oven rack, the door less than 90% open, and the timer at a tenth of its range or more.
notes.MakeIceLemonade: Put a lemon wedge from the fridge and one ice cube from the ice bowl into the glass of lemonade. Success: the wedge and at least one of the two ice cubes touching the glass (centres within 50 cm (x, y) of the glass's centre), and the gripper at least 15 cm from the wedge and from both ice cubes.
notes.PanTransfer: Pick up the pan, pour the vegetable from it onto the plate, then return the pan to the stove. Success: the vegetable on the plate (touching it, its centre within 70% of the plate's radius (x, y) of the plate's centre), the pan touching the stove with its centre within 8 cm (x, y) of a burner, the gripper at least 25 cm from the pan, and the gripper never having touched the vegetable (one touch fails the episode for good).
notes.PortionHotDogs: Place one bun and one sausage from the bowl on each of the two plates. Success: each plate holds exactly one bun and one sausage (each touching it, its centre within 70% of the plate's radius (x, y) of the plate's centre), and the gripper is at least 25 cm from all four.
notes.RecycleBottlesByType: Move each bottle in the middle to its group: plastic bottles to the plastics group, glass bottles to the glass group; the unlabelled middle bottle goes to glass when it is an alcohol bottle and to plastic when it is bottled water. Success: every middle bottle within 30 cm (x, y) of one of its group's two sample bottles, every bottle touching the dining counter, and the gripper at least 25 cm from every bottle.
notes.SeparateFreezerRack: Put the meat container on the freezer's second-highest shelf and the vegetable container on its highest shelf. Success: the meat container touching the second-highest freezer shelf and the vegetable container the highest, their contents still inside, and the gripper at least 25 cm from both containers.
notes.WaffleReheat: Open the microwave, put the bowl with the waffle inside, close the door and turn it on. Success: the waffle in the bowl, the bowl inside the microwave and the microwave on (the start button works only while the door is less than 90% open, and opening it wider switches the microwave off); the door need not be fully shut.
notes.WashFruitColander: Put the colander in the sink, put the fruits into it and run the water over it. Success: every fruit in the colander (touching it, its centre within 70% of the colander's radius (x, y) of the colander's centre) and the colander under the running stream.
notes.WeighIngredients: Place the item on the digital scale, upright, and close the cabinet. Success: the item on the scale (touching it, its centre within 70% of the scale's radius (x, y) of the scale's centre), tilted less than 15 degrees, every cabinet door within 0.5% of its travel from closed, and the gripper at least 25 cm from the item.
